title: Echo of the Stands
blurb: Salma had worked at the old city stadium for eleven years, and she knew its sounds the way a mother knows her child's cry: the creak of the east gate when the wind rose, the click of the wooden seats as the night grew cold…

title: The Cup That Was Never Stolen
blurb: Inspector Nader arrived at the Dawn Sports Club museum at nine in the morning to find three people in front of the entrance, staring at the ground as if awaiting a death sentence.

title: A Message From the Next Hour
blurb: At Weather Station Nine, atop a mountain people climbed only out of necessity, Lina had lived alone for three months with a wind gauge, a radio set, and a grey cat that hated noise.

title: The House That Keeps Voices
blurb: Nabil's family moved into the old stone house on the outskirts of Salt at the end of summer.

title: The Last Bus to Amman
blurb: The bus left Aqaba after sunset carrying five passengers and a driver. Halfway down the desert road, at the kilometer marker with no sign and no house nearby, the engine gave a long sigh and died…

title: The Three Doors in Rain Village
blurb: In the village of "Rain," no rain had fallen for three years. The wells had dried up one after another, except for one ancient well underground, said to have been hidden by the ancestors behind one of three doors…

title: The Eightieth Minute
blurb: Referee Karim found the envelope inside his locker two and a half hours before the final. There was no name on it. It was plain and white, but heavier than it should have been.

title: Room Number Seven
blurb: The invitation reached each of them the same way: a small black card with the number seven in silver, and beneath it a single line: "The old neighborhood team. Thursday evening.

title: The Shepherd and the Ghoul's Question
blurb: It is told that a young shepherd named Salem was herding his sheep near an abandoned well on the edge of the desert when he noticed the flock suddenly stop grazing and raise their heads toward the north.

title: Three Voice Messages
blurb: Yusuf, eleven years old, vanished from his grandmother's house at three in the afternoon and never came back.

title: The Water Chamber
blurb: Dr. Noor had been excavating for three weeks when she noticed that the rock wall in front of her gave off a hollow echo whenever she knocked on it.

title: The Twelfth Player
blurb: It was the summer before we started middle school, and the whole neighborhood was our pitch.
